topic: DeBrota--Stacey, Section III, Conjecture 1 following Theorem 2: equality in the Haar-averaged output-entropy bound for a Luders MIC channel
title: DeBrota--Stacey, Section III, Conjecture 1 after Theorem 2: entropy saturation characterizes SIC measurements

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We prove Section III, Conjecture 1 immediately after Theorem 2 (p. 5) in DeBrota and Stacey, Physical Review A 100, 062327 (2019): a Luders minimal informationally complete channel attains the Haar-averaged output-entropy bound if and only if its measurement is itself a SIC, in every positive finite dimension. An exact entropy-deficit identity gives quantitative bounds, finite two-design tests and an arbitrary-finite-POVM equality characterization by weighted projective two-designs. The same decomposition recovers the entropy-exchange theorem and explains why the postscript's spectral-average replacement requires its saturation hypothesis.
summary: A MIC attains the Haar-mean entropy bound exactly when it is a SIC. For arbitrary finite POVMs, equality characterizes weighted projective two-designs. Exact output-entropy and entropy-exchange deficits, depolarizing endpoint bounds and an anisotropic qubit example complete the coverage.
